eligibility.notes: Regular pay: terms of 1-5 years (annual steps) and 10-30 years (5-year steps), min SA Rs 1 lakh. benefits.death: Pays the sum assured on death during the term; Gold adds an accidental death benefit and Diamond adds critical illness cover.

key_features: Pure risk cover with no maturity benefit or savings element
Three options fixed at purchase: Silver, Gold (accidental death) and Diamond (critical illness, six illnesses)
Entry-level pricing: premiums from Rs 200 a year, sum assured from Rs 30,000
Terms of 1 to 30 years with regular or limited pay
Sold online and through a point-of-sale (POS) variant
products.description: Low-ticket pure term plan with Silver, Gold (accidental death) and Diamond (critical illness) options, aimed at affordable basic protection.
